about: From power-on, the first screens, the title screen with Start and the story's opening scene, then Crash in the first world's hub: he stands long enough for one of his other animations, then runs both ways, jumps, jumps again, spins on the ground and in the air, crouches and gets up, all before he reaches the first fruit or Coco. The original gets to the scene by its own presses, through what the Dreamport doesn't have yet.

onlyInOriginal.about: The load save screen and the main menu, by presses, with A on New Game and on Story Mode.
